channel.title: Comments on: Preparing for the end of the world as we know it

item.title: By: Richard C. Mitchell
item.dc:creator: Richard C. Mitchell
item.description: As a settler-educator-wannabe-ally - thank you. I am crafting a climate change course for 4th year UG students at Brock U and greatly value your insights. While Jem Bendell's DA is at one plausible extreme end of this continuum, the sense I'm getting from the pandemic is, well, anything's possible since no one could really see that coming down the pike either. Seems maybe there really are other ways to adapt and interconnect as we're already doing - Miigwech.
item.content:encoded:
As a settler-educator-wannabe-ally – thank you. I am crafting a climate change course for 4th year UG students at Brock U and greatly value your insights. While Jem Bendell’s DA is at one plausible extreme end of this continuum, the sense I’m getting from the pandemic is, well, anything’s possible since no one could really see that coming down the pike either. Seems maybe there really are other ways to adapt and interconnect as we’re already doing – Miigwech.
